name: Velocity Network
description: Velocity proxy skeleton for a network. Backend registration and forwarding are generated at network creation.

files.velocity.toml:
bind = "0.0.0.0:{{server.port}}"
motd = "{{server.name}}"
show-max-players = 500
online-mode = true
player-info-forwarding-mode = "none"
forwarding-secret-file = "forwarding.secret"
